scope: Four A-06 review findings requested by the user. Existing A-06 changes preserved on the current feature branch.

fixes.finding: Project review summary rescans project history per task and pending request.
fixes.change: One lazily loaded request-scoped path/record index and one paginated history pass, grouped by persistent record key. Shared trust/staleness calculation for detail and summary. One view per matching task.
fixes.regression: server-task-review.test.ts: shares history pages across tasks and requests in both summary endpoints; observed reversion also remains stale in summaries.

fixes.finding: A reverted external content edit leaves a stale verification labelled Passed in the current summary.
fixes.change: Current verification selection uses the same stale-entry test as acceptance. Historical records remain visible.
fixes.regression: web-task-review.test.tsx: excludes verification invalidated by an external edit and revert from the current summary; real Chromium observes change/revert.

fixes.finding: A clean task preview asks to discard because the guard provider exists.
fixes.change: Close invokes the existing dirty-registry confirmation. Without a provider, existing unsaved task edits are checked. Review drafts are protected by the same registry.
fixes.regression: web-task-details-modal-unsaved-navigation.test.tsx: clean close and dirty registered draft; native Chromium exercises the real review form.

fixes.finding: Connected nested review commands lose task-level --json.
fixes.change: Commander optsWithGlobals includes all command ancestors.
fixes.regression: server-task-review.test.ts: real list/request/verify/respond CLI calls with task --json; schemaVersion/kind asserted, plus native agent CLI.

renders unrelated healthy drafts beside an unparsable twin
uses AGENTS.md and completes without opening an editor

selects the next neighbor when the open task is removed

assertions: native nested review commands inherit task JSON
Projects summary shows current assigned request
clean preview closes without a confirmation
declining close preserves the actual review draft
confirming close discards the actual review draft
observed external edit and revert keep verification stale
current verification summary excludes the stale Passed result
historical verification remains readable as previous task content
native Chromium has no unhandled runtime exceptions

performance.database: real temporary SQLite with Markdown before/after snapshots
performance.scope: summary calculation only; excludes project observation, task loading and HTTP

formatOnlyBuildEquivalence.reason: Final formatting-only change in TaskReviewPanel.tsx after initial build; verify minified CLI and assets remain byte-identical.

source.definition: All src files and package.json, bun.lock, bunfig.toml, scripts/build.ts, scripts/run-ci-tests.ts, biome.json, tsconfig.json, README.md.

simplification: One shared history iterator and one trust/staleness calculation; no second workflow model.
Only request-scoped indexes; no persistent cache or invalidation layer.
Existing discard-confirmation hook and Commander ancestor-option API reused.
diagnostics: The first sandboxed API run could not bind loopback ports; rerun with localhost permission. Its API setup failures are environment diagnostics, not accepted regression results.
All four findings reproduced on the original code. Server regression evidence uses the real HTTP service and CLI.
Two Chromium harness attempts corrected selector quoting and the title-field selector. No implementation changes followed. Final 10 checks all pass.

A formatting-only collapse of the verification-selection expression occurred during full CI. The affected DOM pass read the final source; rebuild confirmed all five minified CLI/web outputs byte-identical to the tested bundle.
limits: The 1000-task/1000-event timing compares the original captured summary/view methods with the new methods using the same real temporary SQLite history and preloaded task snapshots. It excludes project observation, task loading and HTTP and is a single local measurement.
13 existing platform/PTY scenarios remain skipped; they are not passes. Linux and temporary projects/accounts only.
The default Biome configuration excludes TSX; explicit same-rule comparison found no added diagnostics (15 to 14 existing errors, 4 warnings unchanged).
Groma is not installed; its managed architecture files and MANIFESTO.md were not changed.
Raw logs, fixtures and the previous binary are under /tmp and are not permanent backups.
No commit, push, merge, personal application restart or Finbee access/change was performed.
